## Checklist

Before submitting, please ensure:

- [ ] JSON syntax is valid (checked with a validator)
- [ ] Event follows the [JSON schema](../blob/main/schema.json)
- [ ] File is in the correct country folder
- [ ] Filename uses kebab-case (lowercase with hyphens)
- [ ] Event ID is unique
- [ ] Description is at least 50 characters
- [ ] Coordinates are accurate
- [ ] At least one reliable source is provided
- [ ] Dates are in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
- [ ] Category is appropriate
- [ ] I've read the [Contributing Guidelines](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
